keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «아는 사람이 없어서 부끄럽다(문제)» 와 «미나가 준의 옆에 앉는다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (Jun does not know anyone and feels shy) and the solution (Mina sits next to him). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Jun and a girl named Mina
It is Jun's first day, and he does not know anyone.
Mina sits next to him and asks about soccer.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

evs: He does not know anyone, so he feels shy.
"Hi! Do you like soccer?" she asks.
Now Jun has a new friend, and school is fun.
why: 새 학교에 아는 사람이 없어서 부끄러워해요. «so» 앞이 이유예요.
He feels shy because he does not know anyone. The reason comes before "so".

qs.q: "At lunch, he sits alone." What does "alone" mean?
qs.qko: «he sits alone» 에서 «alone» 은 무슨 뜻일까요?
opts: with no one next to him
evs: It is Jun's first day at a new school.
Jun smiles and says, "Yes, I love soccer!"
Now Jun has a new friend, and school is fun.
why: «alone» 은 «혼자» 예요. 준 옆에는 아무도 없어요.
"Alone" means with no one else. No one sits with Jun.

qs.q: How does Jun make a new friend?
opts: Mina sits next to him and asks about soccer.
Jun asks the teacher for help.
evs: A girl named Mina sits next to him.
"Hi! Do you like soccer?" she asks.
He does not know anyone, so he feels shy.
It is Jun's first day at a new school.
why: 미나가 옆에 앉고, 축구를 좋아하냐고 물어요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Mina sits next to Jun and asks if he likes soccer. You need both sentences.

ends: Jun and Mina play soccer after school.
준과 미나가 방과 후에 함께 축구를 한다.
A new boy comes, and Jun says hi to him first.
새로 온 아이에게 준이 먼저 인사한다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)
write.src: “I think <u>Mina is kind</u> because <u>she sits next to Jun</u>.”
